title: Intero Biosystems Wins Startup Battlefield at Disrupt 2026
excerpt: Intero Biosystems won the $100,000 grand prize at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 after competing against 199 other companies.
body_html:
Intero Biosystems has emerged as the winner of the Startup Battlefield competition at Disrupt 2026. The company triumphed over a field of 199 other participating startups to secure the victory.

As the winner of the competition, Intero Biosystems was awarded a $100,000 grand prize.
